evidence.quote: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal because: • Our existing multi-layered governance framework, grounded in our foundational AI Principles, robust policies and procedures, and comprehensive technical disclosures, demonstrates the efforts we take to mitigate the risks of generative AI misinformation on our platforms.
